headline: Mooring County and LinnMercy Flare while Weathered Expanse Cools
war_summary: Since the previous edition, strongpoint action has shifted from Weathered Expanse and Fisherman's Row toward LinnMercy, Mooring County, and Stonecradle. All three of the latter recorded actions in the most recent two-hour window, Wiccwalk figuring repeatedly at Mooring County, Outwich Ranch prominent at LinnMercy, and World's End at Stonecradle. Weathered Expanse and Fisherman's Row were quiet by that same two-hour measure, although they still hold the day's heaviest totals, with forty-three and thirty-nine reported strongpoint actions respectively. Stlican Shelf remains plainly active, having tallied twenty-five actions in twenty-four hours, including renewed movement at The Old Mourn and The Pale House. Casualty rolls continue to mount sharply at Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, Callahan's Passage, LinnMercy, and Stonecradle. The war is still undecided: neither side holds thirty-four victory towns.
